name: 21st-dev
description: Use 21st.dev community component patterns (React + Tailwind + shadcn based) as inspiration for polished UI components. Use when building new UI components.
---

# 21st.dev

- Browse https://21st.dev for component patterns (cards, heroes, navbars, inputs, modals, carousels) and adapt them to this project.
- Prefer composable, accessible components styled with Tailwind utility classes / CSS variables.
- Adapt rather than copy verbatim; respect licenses and keep the site's theme.
- The current site is vanilla HTML/JS in site/public; port patterns to plain CSS/JS unless a React build is introduced.
